beats.s0b0: The derivative gives the slope of a curve at one exact point.
beats.s0b1: Draw the tangent line there, a straight line that just touches the curve. Slide the point along the curve, and the tangent slides with it.
beats.s1b0: For this curve, the slope at any x is 0.6 times x.
beats.s1b1: So it is negative on the left, zero at the bottom, and positive on the right.
beats.s1b2: That rule for every slope is the derivative of the function.
